name: Assistance to Trusts/Institutions for Setting Up Cultural Centers/Auditoriums in the Municipal Area
benefit: - **Assistance for New Construction:** 50% of the total cost or ₹30,00,000/- whichever is lower. - **Assistance for Renovation:** Up to ₹15,00,000/-.
_eligibility_text: - A trust or institution operating within the municipal areas of Gujarat shall be eligible for this scheme.
